promptLines: Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: individual Palari V2 character study

Primary request: Create one original Palari. Palari means Personal Artificial Intelligence. A Palari is a small crafted ceramic vessel whose single colored interior reveals its unique intelligence. This character belongs to a coherent species, not a human, conventional robot, toy wearing clothes, or household vessel.
Selected design:
- identity: slim obelisk column with a suspended violet upper oval
- silhouette: tall slender column with a subtly flared stable base
- crown: continuous integrated ceramic dome
- opening: one deliberate vertical oval aperture, suspended high on the torso but below the face
- pose: both rounded arms resting close to the body
- expression: attentive
- exterior material: balanced warm medium-grey stoneware, clearly grey rather than brown
- characteristic color: deep mineral violet (#594077)
Family invariants:
- exactly one complete isolated figure with a stable continuous ceramic base
- tactile fine stoneware exterior with matte-to-satin glaze and subtle handmade microtexture
- exactly one characteristic hue: deep mineral violet only, limited to the recessed inner intelligence, iris accents, and Palari seed mark; no other colored hue
- exactly one dominant architecturally intentional vertical oval opening and no unrelated holes
- exactly two calm half-lidded inset eyes with ceramic eyelids, dark pupils, violet iris accents, and tiny catchlights
- exactly two curved tubular ceramic arms ending in perfectly smooth seamless rounded tips with no hand anatomy; both rest close against the body
- no conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, shoes, or visible human anatomy
- one compact six-aperture Palari seed mark on the lower front: four larger circular apertures at the corners of a compact rectangle plus exactly two smaller apertures centered vertically
- clean intact ceramic with smooth deliberately finished edges
- overall body height at least 2.4 times visible face height
Scene: warm minimalist plaster alcove studio with a matte limestone floor.
Composition: eye-level three-quarter product portrait with minimal lens distortion; direct 1:1 square, full figure visible and centered, occupying about 76 percent of image height.
Lighting: soft diffused daylight from upper left with a gentle contact shadow. Preserve readable ceramic form and inner depth without neon glow.

Avoid: simple horizontal bowl or cup rim, fingers, thumbs, palms, fingernails, realistic hands, conventional legs, knees, feet, toes, shoes, human skin, hair, clothing, jewelry, demographic costume shorthand, multiple characteristic colors, rainbow effects, neon glow, robot joints, screens, wires, exposed machinery, appliance details, random holes, more than one dominant opening, cracks, chips, broken rims, dirt, antique distressing, cups, mugs, vases, planters, lamps, speakers, household appliances, generic mascot smiles, chibi proportions, horror, vacant doll eyes, circular aperture surrounding the face, text, labels, numbers, logos, watermarks, duplicated characters.
prompts.resultReview: Strong selected silhouette, material, opening, eyes, arms, legless base, palette, framing, and scene; seed has five apertures.

promptLines: Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: square Palari mascot logo icon

Input image: Image 1 is an identity reference only, not an edit target. Derive a new symbol from its shell, aperture, eyes, resting arms, and seed family detail. Do not copy its alcove, lighting, material realism, camera scene, or shadow.

Primary request: Create one highly simplified IP mascot logo candidate, not a character illustration, for this exact Palari: a slim obelisk-like column with an integrated rounded dome, one suspended vertical violet oval aperture, two calm half-lidded eyes, two arms resting close, and a compact seed detail. The continuous shell-and-aperture silhouette is the primary identity; the seed is secondary.
Background: fully opaque edge-to-edge uniform solid deep navy #172333, used only for the background.

Subject colors: exactly warm ivory #E9E6DF for the shell, arms, and eyelids; exactly mineral violet #594077 for the single continuous aperture region, two minimal eye marks, and the six-aperture seed family detail. No other semantic colors.
Composition: upright mark emerging from the lower-left corner, filling 75–85% of the square. Preserve both rounded arms and the tall tapered column identity. Square outer corners.

Complexity: approximately 6–10 broad rounded semantic shapes; one dominant continuous outer silhouette; one large continuous violet inner region; only two simple half-lidded eyes and no mouth. Keep the exact six seed apertures tiny and subordinate, grouped as four larger corner circles plus two smaller circles centered vertically.

Style: flat-first vector-friendly geometry with thick rounded weighty contours. Use only one uninterrupted, extremely subtle low-frequency same-family diffuse gradient inside each large IP color region, sharing an upper-left-to-lower-right direction; transition spans at least half the form; total lightness variation at most 0.08; micro-volume visible only at full size and disappearing at 32 × 32.
Small-size requirement: at 32 × 32, the tall dome, violet oval, and resting-arm silhouette must remain immediately readable; the seed may compress but must not become the main logo.

Forbid: source scene, plaster alcove, floor, realistic ceramic, texture, gloss, bevel, extrusion, strong 3D, clay toy rendering, cast shadow, contact shadow, highlight patches, closed shadow shapes, halo, vignette, background gradient, border, frame, App-icon mask, rounded canvas corners, transparency, text, watermark, mouth, eyebrows, nose, fingers, hands, legs, feet, clothing, machinery, extra openings, extra colors, decorative marks, thin lines, sharp points, centered sticker composition.
prompts.resultReview: The identity is readable, but the mark is centered, the seed count is five, and the navy background has a visible vignette.
